# Small Biz Waste

> Plain-language hazardous waste training for small businesses: RCRA generator, satellite accumulation, universal waste, manifests, spill prevention and awareness, with small generator checklists.

Small Biz Waste (https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Generator Training, Satellite Areas, Universal Waste, Manifest or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). Everything a small business owner needs to know about hazardous waste rules. Enroll: https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [Hazardous Waste Satellite Accumulation Area Training](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training): $59.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262.15. The waste container by the workbench, done right. Enroll: https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training?buy=415
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Batteries, bulbs, aerosol cans and mercury devices. Enroll: https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602
- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262 Subpart B (RCRA). What you're signing when the waste truck comes. Enroll: https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training?buy=580
- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing and handling small spills. Enroll: https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Knowing when a spill is too big to handle yourself. Enroll: https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

## Guides

- [Is my small business a hazardous waste generator?](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/guides/is-my-business-a-hazardous-waste-generator): If you make waste paint, solvents, chemicals or certain cleaners, probably yes. Here's how to tell, and what it means.
- [A one-page hazardous waste checklist for small businesses](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/guides/small-business-hazardous-waste-checklist): Print it, tape it to the wall, check it monthly.
- [Choosing a hazardous waste vendor](https://small-business.hazwoperosha.us/guides/choosing-a-hazardous-waste-vendor): Your waste is still your responsibility after it leaves. How to pick a vendor you can trust.
